# REAL-PhD

> > Open-access Hungarian PhD dissertation repository powered by EPrints, aggregating doctoral theses from participating Hungarian universities.

REAL-PhD is a digital archive maintained by the Hungarian Academy of Sciences that collects and preserves PhD dissertations from Hungarian universities in an open-access institutional repository. The platform enables discovery and access to doctoral research through multiple browsing and search mechanisms.

## Key Topics

- PhD dissertations
- open-access repository
- Hungarian universities
- EPrints platform
- institutional repository

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to REAL-PhD](https://real-phd.mtak.hu): Homepage for REAL-PhD, Hungarian PhD thesis open-access repository
- [About the Repository](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/information.html): About REAL-PhD repository, participating universities, and deposit instructions

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse by Subject](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/view/subjects): Browse dissertations by Library of Congress subject classification
- [Browse by Author](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/view/creators): Browse PhD dissertations alphabetically by author in REAL-PhD
- [Browse by Year](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/view/year): Browse PhD dissertations chronologically by year in REAL-PhD repository
- [Latest Additions](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/cgi/latest): Latest PhD dissertations added to REAL-PhD repository
- [Latest 20 Additions](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/cgi/latest_tool): Display latest 20 PhD thesis additions to REAL-PhD repository

## Repository Information

- [Policies](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/policies.html): Repository policies covering metadata, copyright, preservation, and access
- [Repository Statistics](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/cgi/stats/report): Usage statistics and analytics dashboard for REAL-PhD repository
- [About EPrints](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/eprints): Information about EPrints 3.3.15 software powering REAL-PhD

## Optional

- [Language Selection](https://real-phd.mtak.hu/cgi/set_lang): Language selection utility for REAL-PhD repository
